evidence: The EXAFS results for TiO2 indicated that the Pt-Pt coordination number gradually increased from 4.8 to 6.8 between one and four ALD cycles using O2 treatment. Therefore, the Pt particle size slightly increased from 1.1 to 2.1 nm. The Pt-Pt bond distances also increased from 2.65 to 2.71 Å. With H2 treatment, however, the Pt particle size remained approximately constant at 1.5 nm for one to three cycles of ALD, even though there was a large increase in Pt loading.
